svg.title: G7 whole-schedule coverage by day
svg.desc: Flights per day across 30 planning days, around 171 per day, each bar stacked into fully crewed (gray), understaffed (amber) and cancelled (red). Coverage is 99 to 100 percent on most days; cancellations are negligible until the horizon tail, peaking at 16 on day 30 and 9 each on days 25 and 28, with 6 each on the spoke days 11 and 18.
